card.name: Hyphen-split words before -collected/-colony
card.fires_on: The hyphen or break just before a word that continues with 'col' or 'collect', such as clinician-collected, field-collected, tax-collecting, granulocyte-colony. Also fires on breaks inside words like anticoagulant and colleagues.

modes.description: A hyphen after a noun, just before a form of 'collected' or 'collecting'.

card.writes: It raises 'col' word starts and lowers 'gather' words, so it pushes toward collect-type words over gather-type words.
card.plain: It spots a point where the next piece of the word is 'col…', as in clinician-collected or granulocyte-colony.
